primitive.ashen_frontier.controls: Use with material or a tool to insert (sneak for a batch of material). Sneak-use the top with an empty hand to select a recipe, or a side to withdraw. Empty-hand use starts work or collects output; sneak-use cancels active work. Stay within 4 m.
primitive.ashen_frontier.working: Working. Materials, tool and output space are checked before completion. Leaving pauses work; interact to resume.
primitive.ashen_frontier.ready: Idle. Check material, tool, research and selected process.
primitive.ashen_frontier.observe_pebble: Pebble observed. Sneak-use to place a knapping surface. Assemble a hammer from a pebble, then make a chopper at the surface.
primitive.ashen_frontier.observe_fiber: Plant fiber observed. At the surface, twist 1 kg into nine 0.1 kg lengths of cordage.
Observe a pebble in the main hand by using it, then make a chopper at the surface without research. Unlock bifaces for cutting and 2x2 assembly with a handle and cordage into axes or adzes. These cannot mine hard rock. 2x2 assembly: axe = biface top left, handle bottom left, cordage bottom right; adze = biface top right, handle bottom left, cordage bottom right (mirroring is allowed).
Observe plant fiber in the main hand by using it, then make cordage at the surface without research. Weave nine lengths on the fiber-working frame at the surface into cloth for later filters and wooden pumps.
research_condition.ashen_frontier.primit: Use a pebble in the main hand to observe it
Use plant fiber in the main hand to observe it
Make a chopper at the surface
primitive.ashen_frontier.thermal_control: Use to insert material (sneak for a batch). Empty-hand use starts work or collects products. Sneak-use the top to select, a side to withdraw, or the bottom to extinguish. Sneak-use cancels work. Insert fuel and tinder, then use the hearth with the bow drill in your main hand.
primitive.ashen_frontier.fire_requiremen: Dry tinder, dry wood, cover and ventilation are required. Use the hearth with the drill in your main hand and stay within 4 m for 30 real seconds. No research is required for the first fire.
primitive.ashen_frontier.environment_mis: Required environmental information, materials, research or hearth heat is unavailable. Materials and water are retained.
primitive.ashen_frontier.igniting: Starting a friction fire. Keep holding the tool and stay near the hearth.
primitive.ashen_frontier.lit: Burning. Firing advances only with suitable material, temperature and heat. Fuel exhaustion pauses work.
tooltip.ashen_frontier.wet: Added water: unsuitable as tinder or fuel
tooltip.ashen_frontier.pot_capacity: Water capacity: 4 kg. Small leaks from low-fired pottery are omitted.
tooltip.ashen_frontier.pottery_steps: Shape at the surface, dry for one game day on a covered ventilated rack, then fire for at least 120 real seconds in a lit hearth.
research.ashen_frontier.t0.fire.descript: Assemble a handle, branch, cordage and pebble in the 2x2 grid to make a drill. Loosen fiber into tinder at the surface. Assemble a hearth from two pebbles and clay, and a rack from two branches and two lengths of cordage. Supply dry tinder and wood, cover and ventilation, then work the drill at the hearth for 30 real seconds. The first fire needs no research. Shape pottery from 2 kg clay, 0.5 kg sand and 0.5 kg raw or clean water. Pour water into the surface from a container; it is consumed only on completion.
research.ashen_frontier.t0.pottery.descr: Dry 3 kg of green pottery for one game day on a covered ventilated rack; 0.5 kg of free water leaves a 2.5 kg dry body. Fire for 120 real seconds with sufficient heat in the suitable hearth range of 973–1123 K. Lids and tubes follow the same stages, with five pieces per batch. Fuel shortage or full outputs retains materials. Beware hot pottery and ventilation; a hearth does not make a room safe.
research_condition.ashen_frontier.primit: Light a hearth using a bow drill
primitive.ashen_frontier.unsuitable_envi: Cover, ventilation, temperature or humidity is unsuitable. Work is paused with materials retained.
primitive.ashen_frontier.heat_unknown: The hearth temperature is not yet known.
primitive.ashen_frontier.heat_cold: The hearth is below the firing range.
primitive.ashen_frontier.heat_hot: The hearth is above the firing range.
primitive.ashen_frontier.heat_suitable: The hearth is in the firing range. Check materials, research and fuel.
primitive.ashen_frontier.drying_conditio: Drying advances only in covered, ventilated, unfrozen conditions at no more than 80% relative humidity.
primitive.ashen_frontier.stored_water: Surface tank: %s kg, %s. Sneak-use with an empty ceramic pot to withdraw water.
